tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a strict3 by3 row-major grid of NINE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Otton Frog shown in image1; identity features: 金褐色の斑・淡い腹・丸い指表現・尾なし. Preserve the reference’s large head, exact torso LENGTH and WIDTH, short upright two-legged body and two arm-like forepaws. Never shorten/slim the torso or enlarge the head relative to it. Keep exactly the existing2 arms,2 legs and existing tail/horns/ears; do not create a tail on a tailless reference. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: Same exact upright/resting body position, head size, torso length/width, limbs, supports and facing as image1, ONLY the eye(s) gently fully closed as a simple brown lid curve; mouth/expression otherwise unchanged. Do not crouch, nod, shrink or move the body during blink. 2 GREET: Friendly one-forepaw gentle raised greeting, feet planted and head/body scale unchanged. 3 PRESENT_LEFT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER LEFT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. 4 PRESENT_RIGHT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER RIGHT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. Generate a fresh matching opposite gesture, not a flip-copy. 5 THINK: One existing forepaw gently touches chin, curious head tilt, torso stable. 6 AHA: Small pleased discovery reaction: head perks and one forepaw slightly lifts, friendly eyes; no lightbulb/effect. 7 CHEER: Gentle pleased grounded celebration, two connected forepaws comfortably lifted, smiling closed eyes allowed; no jump or new props. 8 SPECIES_A: A very small two-footed knee bend lowers the short torso slightly while both feet remain planted. 9 SPECIES_B: Part-way rising back toward neutral, with the same two small arms and feet and unchanged standing-equivalent scale. Species constraint: 跳躍や四足への変更を含めない。尾を追加せず、既存の丸い指・斑の配色を維持。しゃがみ画像を個別bbox-fitで拡大しない。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.
